items.name: The UpScale Tail
items.angle: Award-winning Naperville grooming site has strong trust proof and specialist care, but crowded navigation and long certification copy bury the appointment path for new pet owners.

items.name: Naperville Pressure Washing
items.angle: Pressure washing site has local service breadth and free-estimate intent, but long SEO-heavy copy and repeated CTA bands make it harder for homeowners to pick the right cleaning path.

items.name: Pressure Soft Pros LLC
items.vertical: pressure washing, concrete cleaning, and house washing
items.angle: Pressure Soft Pros has a clear Naperville service footprint, but long residential/commercial menus, service-area sprawl, and “reviews coming soon” proof need a tighter estimate-first homepage.

items.name: The Power Boys Pressure Washing
items.vertical: pressure washing, soft washing, roof cleaning, and window cleaning
items.angle: Power Boys has strong brand energy and 5.0/182-review proof, but slider-style hero choices and dense service navigation need a sharper same-day-estimate path.

items.name: Lou's Lawn Care
items.angle: Lou’s Lawn Care has a warm local story, insurance proof, and real reviews, but broad lawn/landscape/seasonal services need a clearer estimate-first homepage hierarchy.

items.name: Anderson Window & Gutter Cleaning
items.vertical: window cleaning, gutter services, power washing, and drainage
items.angle: Anderson has excellent trust proof — veteran fireman owned, 1997 history, insurance, guarantee — but dense old-school formatting and duplicated service cards bury the estimate path.

items.name: Six Paws Pet Care Inc.
items.angle: Six Paws has a warm local pet-care brand and direct contact info, but the current page is too thin to answer owner questions before they request care.

items.name: C&A Landscaping
items.vertical: landscaping, hardscaping, lawn care, irrigation, and snow removal
items.angle: C&A has decades of family-owned landscaping credibility and Unilock proof, but the older one-page layout and giant gallery need a clearer quote-first path.

items.name: WoofBeach
items.vertical: dog grooming, dog training, daycare, and walk-in services
items.angle: WoofBeach has a memorable tropical brand and broad dog-care services, but the huge navigation needs a simpler grooming/training/daycare booking path.

items.name: TMV Services LLC
items.vertical: licensed home remodeling and handyman-style improvement services
items.angle: TMV already has strong licensing, reviews, and project proof, but repeated forms and broad homeowner/commercial/government messaging need a tighter estimate-first path.
